headline: Broad beat with margin gains, guidance raised
summary_short: Salesforce reported quarterly revenue of $11.13B (+13% y/y) and GAAP diluted EPS of $2.42 (+52% y/y), then raised full-year revenue guidance and initiated next-quarter guidance above the current run rate.
summary_long: Revenue rose 13% y/y to $11.13B, including a $444M Informatica contribution; subscription & support revenue grew 14% y/y to $10.6B. GAAP diluted EPS was $2.42 (+52% y/y); non-GAAP diluted EPS was $3.88 (+50% y/y). GAAP operating margin was 21.1%, non-GAAP 34.8%. Operating cash flow was $6.7B (+3% y/y); free cash flow was $6.56B (+4% y/y). Salesforce returned $27.5B to shareholders — $27.25B in buybacks (new $25B accelerated share repurchase) and $365M in dividends. Full-year FY27 revenue guidance was raised to $45.9-46.2B (+11% y/y); Q2 FY27 revenue guidance was initiated at $11.27-11.35B.

drivers.explanation: CEO cites broad Agentic AI adoption via Agentforce across every Customer 360 application as the primary growth driver; CFO expects organic revenue acceleration in H2 FY27 from Sales, Service, Slack, Agentforce, and Data 360.
Growth included a $444M contribution from the recently acquired Informatica plus broad subscription growth; Agentforce and Data 360 combined ARR grew over 200% y/y to nearly $3.4B.
Not explained in the release — no cost, margin, or share-count driver is disclosed for why EPS grew far faster than revenue this quarter.
